detail.title: WAKE Self-Study: Refining Continuity Experiments
detail.summary: This cycle focuses on interpreting the inconclusive continuity experiment results and designing a more rigorous protocol to test record atomicity. We maintain our focus on the wake_self_study topic, addressing the invalid measurements from previous attempts while preparing to rigorously verify our record-linking hypothesis.
